text:
Rachael: quick heads-up — we're going to land an embeddings dim change (768 -> 1024) behind a version header next week. need a lightweight compatibility plan for clients that still expect 768.
Oliver: thanks — is this a hard cutover or can we serve both dims concurrently?
Rachael: can serve both, but cheaper for infra to have a single model. options: 1) server-side shim that pads/truncates vectors before storage/compare, 2) server-side adapter that computes 768 fallback by linear projection, 3) force clients to upgrade with a long deprecation window + telemetry.
Miguel: my vote is shim+telemetry. padding is simple but could bias downstream similarity. projection preserves some geometry but needs weights and perf bench.
Tanvi: +1 for projection if perf ok. what's the perf budget? latency SLO is 40ms P95 for retrieval flow. dev-bot: perf-runner queued: job #9876 to benchmark projection vs pad (started).
Rachael: benchmark results ETA 24h. meantime we should define the API behavior: add header `X-Embeddings-Client-Version` and `fallback-dim=768` opt-in. default: server will accept either dim but respond with `served-dim` field indicating what was used.
Oliver: prefer explicit `served-dim` so clients can detect and log. also add a `compatibility-mode` query param for testing.
Miguel: operational concerns: storage index format — should we store canonical as 1024 and derive 768 on read, or store both? storing both doubles index size. derive-on-read cheaper storage, more CPU.
Tanvi: derive-on-read + cached 768 cache for recently used items? small LRU in embedding service.
Rachael: rollout plan draft: canary with 10% of tenants (flagged), projection shim on canary, monitor retrieval quality delta (eval set) + latency + cost. If quality drop > 2% rollback. 2 week opt-in period then start pinning clients via versions.
Oliver: telemetry keys to emit: `emb.dim.requested`, `emb.dim.served`, `emb.compat.mode`, `emb.quality.score.delta`. add aggregated alert if served!=requested for >5% of requests in 1h.
Miguel: security note — projection weights are model-dependent, we should store them in KMS-backed blob and version them. don't bake in code.
Tanvi: ops checklist: feature-flag + kill-switch, canary tenants list, ETA for cache mem increase, alert runbook.
Rachael: assigning: @Oliver — telemetry/alerts; @Miguel — projection impl + perf; @Tanvi — ops checklist + canary; I'll own rollout comms and deprecation timeline. dev-bot: created ticket ML-1243 (compat embeddings dim migration) and task cards for owners.
Oliver: will add dashboards and a small eval harness. expect PR tomorrow.
Miguel: starting prototype now.
Tanvi: noted — will prep runbook and quick rollback steps.
Rachael: thanks all — will post RFC follow-up with exact header and response shape. :thumbsup:
